creator.title: About the creator
creator.name: Elena Revicheva
creator.intro: Hi, I'm Elena, founder of AIdeazz, where I build AI companions for real family life.
creator.journeyIntro: EspaLuz is where AIdeazz began. My journey to it was deeply personal:
creator.b1: Former IT executive and Chief Legal Officer in Russia's e-government.
creator.b2: Relocated to Panama in 2022 as a single mother with:
creator.b2c: Mom spoke Russian and English, Dad only English
creator.b2end: This wasn't an adventure. It was a real challenge for all of us.
creator.b3: no profession left, no Spanish, no network.
creator.b3b: Language apps felt cold and robotic, nothing like the warm, patient help my three-generation family needed.
creator.b3c: So I built EspaLuz: first for my own family, now for yours. AI helped me rebuild my life from scratch, and that is the path I share through AIdeazz.
creator.connectBody: Want to work together, or just say hola? My professional outlook and portfolio are here.
creator.buildBody: The future of learning is warm, culturally aware and family-focused.
